name: Summer (Fire)
category: Jon Brazer Enterprises – Domains and Subdomains
body:
Associated Domain: Fire.

Replacement Power: The following granted power replaces the fire resistance power of the Fire domain.

Summer Warmth (Su): Your body is filled with the warmth of summer, keeping the chill of winter away. At 6th level, you gain resist cold 10. This resistance increases to 20 at 12th level. At 20th level, you gain immunity to cold.

Replacement Domain Spells: 1st—endure elements, 4th— detonate (fire only), 6th—fiery blast

Book of Magic: Insurgency of Summer © 2013, Jon Brazer Enterprises; Author: Dale C. McCoy, Jr.
